items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: This boy Bob had lost the music

ctx.x: I haven't listened to it really that close. But I know Louis didn't care a damn thing about it. He didn't care.

So we went on tour the next day, and forgot about "Hello Dolly". This boy Bob had lost the music; he was supposed to be the band boy. And it was all forgotten until we wound up in San Juan, Puerto Rico, around Christmas. We opened in San Juan, Puerto Rico. We were supposed to be there nine days I believe at the Hotel El San Juan.
Oh, I've played there, yes. A big old place...
